record_title: Fractional midpoint noise creates configurational superconvergence in UBU-type Langevin sampling
provenance: Exact stationary-covariance analysis of an interpolation between LC-UBU and classical UBU on quadratic underdamped-Langevin targets.
limitations: The higher-order result concerns invariant position covariance for quadratic Gaussian targets, not nonlinear trajectory order. Nonzero midpoint-noise interpolation does not retain LC-UBU's reduced Gaussian count, and exact finite-step zero-bias tuning becomes mode dependent.
